followUps.title: Catalog page numbers below 1 (?page=0 or negative) are not checked
followUps.reason: They are passed to the catalog API as a negative page index; the story covers only pages past the last one.

followUps.title: Catalog API overflows on large pageIndex
followUps.reason: CatalogApi.GetAllItems computes Skip(pageSize * pageIndex) in int, so a large pageIndex makes the skip value negative and the request fails instead of returning a validation error.
